title: Basic-Fit: Increasing Returns to Scale - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 47]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle, and today we’re breaking down Europe’s leading low-cost gym operator, Basic-Fit.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle, and today we’re breaking down Europe’s leading low-cost gym operator, Basic-Fit. Netherlands based Basic-Fit is a story of rapid expansion. Today, they operate over a 1000 clubs across 5 countries, and have 2 million combined members in their system.

key_points.text: To break down the business, I’m joined by Jonathan Abenaim from Arlen House Capital, who is an investor in Basic-Fit.
We cover a history of fitness clubs dating back to the late 70’s and early 80’s.
Please enjoy this breakdown of Basic-Fit.
